title: 根据以下报告更新roadmap，并合并简化roadmap中已完成的部分。
body:
# 📊 ObjectUI Protocol Consistency Assessment

## `objectstack-ai/spec` (Protocol) vs `objectstack-ai/objectui` (Renderer)

---

## 1. Architecture Overview

| Layer | `@objectstack/spec` (Protocol) | `@object-ui/types` (Renderer) | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Schema Paradigm** | Zod Schemas → `z.infer<>` | TypeScript Interfaces (manual) | ⚠️ Dual Source |
| **Validation** | Runtime Zod `.parse()` | No runtime validation | ⚠️ Gap |
| **Children Model** | `children[]` in `PageRegionSchema`, `regions[]` in `PageSchema` | `body`, `children`, `SchemaNode[]` mixed | ⚠️ Inconsistent |
| **i18n** | `I18nLabelSchema` (string \| { en, zh, ... }) | Plain `string` | 🔴 Gap |
| **ARIA** | `AriaPropsSchema` on all schemas | Not present | 🔴 Gap |

---

## 2. Module-by-Module Comparison

### 2.1 App / Navigation — `app.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI

| Feature | `spec` `AppSchema` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| App Shell (`name`, `label`, `icon`, `branding`) | ✅ Complete | ❌ No `AppSchema` type | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Navigation Tree (7 types: object, dashboard, page, url, report, action, group) | ✅ Recursive union | ❌ Only `HeaderBarSchema` + `SidebarSchema` (no nav tree) | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Navigation Areas (business domain partitioning) | ✅ `NavigationAreaSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Mobile Navigation | ✅ `mobileNavigation` (drawer/bottom_nav/hamburger) | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Permission Guards (`requiredPermissions`, `visible`) | ✅ On every nav item | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Sharing / Embed | ✅ `SharingConfigSchema`, `EmbedConfigSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |

**Verdict:** ObjectUI has **no renderer implementation** for the App Shell or navigation protocol. The Console cannot render a navigation sidebar from spec JSON today.

---

### 2.2 View — `view.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI

| Feature | `spec` `ListViewSchema` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| List View types: grid, kanban, gallery, calendar, timeline, gantt, map | ✅ 7 types | Partial: `data-table`, `kanban`, `calendar-view` exist | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| `ViewDataSchema` (object/api/value providers) | ✅ Discriminated union | ❌ Not present; DataTable takes raw `data[]` | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `ListColumnSchema` (field, width, align, pinned, summary, link, action) | ✅ Rich column config | ⚠️ `DataTableSchema` has `columns` with `header`/`accessorKey` (TanStack-style) | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| Kanban Config (`groupByField`, `summarizeField`) | ✅ `KanbanConfigSchema` | ⚠️ `KanbanSchema` uses pre-built `columns: KanbanColumn[]` (data, not config) | ⚠️ **Different level** |
| Calendar Config (`startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`) | ✅ Field-binding | ⚠️ `CalendarViewSchema` uses pre-built `events: CalendarEvent[]` | ⚠️ **Different level** |
| Gallery / Timeline / Gantt / Map | ✅ Configs defined | ❌ No renderers | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Selection, Pagination, Row Height, Grouping, Row Color | ✅ All present | ⚠️ DataTable has `pagination`, `selectable` but not `rowHeight`, `grouping`, `rowColor` | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| Quick Filters, Searchable/Filterable Fields | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Inline Edit, Export, Virtual Scroll | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Row/Bulk Actions | ✅ `rowActions`, `bulkActions` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Conditional Formatting | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Airtable Parity (userActions, appearance, tabs, addRecord, showRecordCount, allowPrinting) | ✅ Complete | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Empty State | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Navigation Config (page/drawer/modal/split/popover/new_window) | ✅ `NavigationConfigSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |

**Spec's `FormViewSchema`:**

| Feature | `spec` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Form types: simple, tabbed, wizard, split, drawer, modal | ✅ 6 types | ⚠️ `FormSchema` is a flat form, no layout modes | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| Sections with column layout | ✅ `FormSectionSchema` with 1-4 columns | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Field config (widget override, dependsOn, visibleOn, colSpan) | ✅ `FormFieldSchema` | ⚠️ `FormField` in ObjectUI has basic `name`/`label`/`type` | ⚠️ **Partial** |

**Verdict:** The spec has a **metadata-driven** approach (field bindings → auto-resolve to columns/events), while ObjectUI has a **data-driven** approach (pre-materialized data arrays). The bridge layer that transforms spec metadata to ObjectUI renderer props is **entirely missing**.

---

### 2.3 Page — `page.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI `PageSchema`

| Feature | `spec` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Page Types (16: record, home, app, utility, dashboard, grid, list, gallery, kanban, calendar, timeline, form, record_detail, record_review, overview, blank) | ✅ 16 types | ⚠️ 4 types: `record`, `home`, `app`, `utility` | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| Regions (header/sidebar/main/footer) | ✅ `PageRegionSchema` | ✅ `PageRegion` (aligned) | ✅ **Aligned** |
| Variables (local page state) | ✅ `PageVariableSchema` (6 types inc. `record_id`) | ⚠️ `PageVariable` (5 types, missing `record_id`) | ⚠️ **Minor gap** |
| Page Components (30+ types with namespaced IDs) | ✅ `PageComponentType` enum | ❌ Not present; ObjectUI uses raw `SchemaNode` | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Event Handlers (expression-based actions) | ✅ `events: Record<string, string>` | ❌ Not present in page model | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Blank Page Layout (grid canvas) | ✅ `BlankPageLayoutSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Record Review Config | ✅ `RecordReviewConfigSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Interface Page Config (Airtable parity) | ✅ `InterfacePageConfigSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Responsive Config | ✅ Per-component `ResponsiveConfigSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |

**Verdict:** The `regions` model is aligned ✅, but the rich page composition model (components, events, blank layout, interface config) has no ObjectUI counterpart.

---

### 2.4 Dashboard — `dashboard.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI `DashboardSchema`

| Feature | `spec` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Basic Structure (name, label, widgets) | ✅ | ⚠️ Has `type: 'dashboard'` + `widgets[]` but no `name`/`label` | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| Widget Layout (x, y, w, h) | ✅ Required | ✅ `DashboardWidgetLayout` | ✅ **Aligned** |
| Widget Type (ChartType: metric, bar, pie, line...) | ✅ `ChartTypeSchema` | ⚠️ `type?: string` (untyped) | ⚠️ **Loose** |
| Data Binding (object, filter, categoryField, valueField, aggregate) | ✅ Full metadata binding | ❌ Not present (widget uses `component: SchemaNode`) | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Global Filters | ✅ `GlobalFilterSchema` with dynamic `optionsFrom` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Date Range Filter | ✅ 14 presets + custom | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Dashboard Header (actions, show/hide title) | ✅ `DashboardHeaderSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Widget Color Variants | ✅ 8 variants | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Multi-Measure (pivot/matrix) | ✅ `WidgetMeasureSchema` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Performance / Responsive | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Auto-refresh | ✅ `refreshInterval` | ✅ `refreshInterval` | ✅ **Aligned** |

**Verdict:** Dashboard widget layout is aligned, but the **entire data-binding** and **filter** model from spec has no ObjectUI implementation. The ObjectUI dashboard is a dumb grid; the spec dashboard is a BI engine.

---

### 2.5 Action — `action.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI

| Feature | `spec` | `objectui` | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Action Schema (name, label, type, target, variant, params) | ✅ Complete | ❌ **No Action type in ObjectUI** | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Action Types (script, url, modal, flow, api) | ✅ 5 types | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Action Locations (list_toolbar, list_item, record_header, record_more, global_nav) | ✅ Present | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Confirmation Dialog | ✅ `confirmText` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Keyboard Shortcuts | ✅ `shortcut` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Bulk Operations | ✅ `bulkEnabled` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |
| Refresh After | ✅ `refreshAfter` | ❌ Not present | 🔴 **Missing** |

**Verdict:** The entire Action protocol has **zero implementation** in ObjectUI. Buttons exist as Shadcn primitives but have no concept of declarative action execution.

---

### 2.6 Component — `component.zod.ts` vs ObjectUI

| spec Component Type | ObjectUI Equivalent | Status |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `page:header` | `HeaderBarSchema` (partial) | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `page:tabs` | `TabsSchema` | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `page:card` | `CardSchema` | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `record:details` | ❌ None | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `record:related_list` | ❌ None | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `record:highlights` | ❌ None | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `record:activity` | `TimelineSchema` (very loose match) | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `record:chatter` | ❌ None | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `record:path` | ❌ None | 🔴 **Missing** |
| `ai:chat_window` | `ChatbotSchema` | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `element:text` | `TextSchema` | ✅ Aligned |
| `element:number` | `StatisticSchema` (loose) | ⚠️ **Partial** |
| `element:image` | `ImageSchema` | ✅ Aligned |
| `element:button` | `ButtonSchema` | ✅ Aligned (primitive level) |
| `element:filter` | `FilterBuilderSchema` | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `element:form` | `FormSchema` | ⚠️ **Different shape** |
| `element:record_picker` | `ComboboxSchema` (loose) | ⚠️ **Partial** |

---

### 2.7 Additional Spec Protocols with No ObjectUI Support

| Spec Protocol | File | ObjectUI Status |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Report** | `report.zod.ts` | 🔴 No `ReportSchema` renderer |
| **Theme** | `theme.zod.ts` | 🔴 No spec theme integration |
| **Chart** | `chart.zod.ts` | ⚠️ ObjectUI has `ChartSchema` but not spec-aligned |
| **DnD** | `dnd.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Touch** | `touch.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Keyboard** | `keyboard.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Animation** | `animation.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Notification** | `notification.zod.ts` | ⚠️ `ToastSchema` exists but not spec-aligned |
| **Responsive** | `responsive.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Offline** | `offline.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |
| **Sharing** | `sharing.zod.ts` | 🔴 Not present |

---

## 3. Structural / Naming Inconsistencies

| Issue | `spec` | `objectui` | Severity |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Children prop name** | `regions[].components`, `children` in `PageComponent` | `body`, `children`, `content` mixed | 🟡 Medium |
| **Field vs Column** | `field` (snake_case field name) | `accessorKey` (TanStack convention) | 🟡 Medium |
| **Schema Node** | `PageComponentSchema` with `type`, `id`, `properties`, `events` | `BaseSchema` with `type`, `id`, `[key: string]: any` | 🟡 Medium |
| **Data Binding** | `bind`, `dataSource`, `ViewDataSchema` | None — raw `data` prop | 🔴 High |
| **Expression Engine** | `visible`, `disabled` → expression strings | `hidden: boolean` (static only) | 🔴 High |

---

## 4. Summary Scorecard

| Protocol Area | Spec Coverage | ObjectUI Coverage | Gap |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Atom Components** (Button, Input, Badge, etc.) | N/A (Not spec's job) | ✅ 50+ Shadcn components | ✅ |
| **Layout Primitives** (Flex, Grid, Card, Tabs) | N/A | ✅ Complete | ✅ |
| **App Shell / Navigation** | ✅ Complete (7 nav types, areas, mobile) | 🔴 0% implemented | 🔴 |
| **List View** (Grid/Kanban/Calendar/Gantt/Gallery/Timeline/Map) | ✅ Complete | ⚠️ ~30% (data-table, kanban, calendar exist but not spec-aligned) | 🟡 |
| **Form View** (simple/tabbed/wizard/split/drawer/modal) | ✅ Complete | ⚠️ ~20% (basic FormSchema only) | 🟡 |
| **Page Composition** | ✅ Complete (16 types, regions, variables, blank layout) | ⚠️ ~25% (regions aligned, missing page types/components) | 🟡 |
| **Dashboard** | ✅ Complete (data-binding, filters, measures) | ⚠️ ~15% (grid layout only) | 🟡 |
| **Action Protocol** | ✅ Complete | 🔴 0% implemented | 🔴 |
| **Report** | ✅ Complete | 🔴 0% implemented | 🔴 |
| **Data Binding Bridge** | ✅ `ViewDataSchema`, `ElementDataSourceSchema` | 🔴 0% implemented | 🔴 |
| **Expression Engine** | ✅ Referenced in `visible`/`disabled`/`events` | 🔴 0% (static booleans only) | 🔴 |
| **i18n / ARIA** | ✅ On every schema | 🔴 0% | 🔴 |

**Overall Alignment: ~20%**

---

## 5. Can the Current ObjectUI API Support Full Console Development?

### ✅ What CAN be built today:
1. **Static component demos** — Buttons, Inputs, Cards, Tables with hardcoded data
2. **Basic page layouts** — Using Flex/Grid/Container/Tabs
3. **Storybook component library** — Isolated Shadcn primitives

### 🔴 What CANNOT be built today:
1. **App Shell with dynamic navigation** — No AppSchema renderer, no sidebar from JSON
2. **Metadata-driven List Views** — No bridge from `{ type: 'grid', columns: ['name', 'status'], data: { provider: 'object', object: 'task' } }` to a rendered DataTable
3. **Metadata-driven Forms** — No bridge from `FormViewSchema` sections to rendered form fields
4. **Dashboard with data binding** — Widgets can't auto-query objects by `categoryField`/`valueField`
5. **Action execution** — No way to interpret `{ type: 'script', target: 'approve_contract' }` 
6. **Record pages** — No `record:details`, `record:related_list`, `record:activity` components
7. **Expression evaluation** — No `visible: "${data.role === 'admin'}"` support
8. **Report rendering** — No report engine
9. **Real-time filtering / search** — No quick filters, searchable fields, or global dashboard filters

---

## 6. Recommended Priority Actions

| Priority | Action | Impact |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **P0** | Build `@object-ui/react` **SpecBridge** — transforms `@objectstack/spec` View/Page/App JSON → ObjectUI `SchemaNode` tree | Unlocks console development |
| **P0** | Implement **AppShell renderer** consuming `AppSchema` (sidebar + navigation tree) | Core console navigation |
| **P0** | Implement **Expression Engine** (`visible`/`disabled`/`events` string evaluation) in `@object-ui/core` | Dynamic UI behavior |
| **P1** | Align `ListViewSchema` → `DataTableSchema` bridge (field → column mapping, data provider) | List views |
| **P1** | Implement **Action Runtime** in `@object-ui/core` (execute `ActionSchema` from JSON) | All interactive features |
| **P1** | Build `record:details`, `record:related_list`, `record:highlights` components | Record pages |
| **P2** | Align Dashboard data binding (widget ↔ object query) | BI dashboards |
| **P2** | Add i18n support to all components (accept `string | I18nLabel`) | Internationalization |
| **P2** | Add `FormViewSchema` renderer (sections, columns, widget overrides) | Form layouts |
| **P3** | Gantt, Timeline, Gallery, Map view renderers | Advanced views |
| **P3** | Report renderer | Analytics |
